tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams bshad bzhugs so// bla ma rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas/ /bka' stod chos srung dam can rgya mtsho la/ /lus ngag yid gsum dang bas gus btud nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod phrin las kyi/ /kha skong phyir dang yi dam lha tshogs rnams/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa legs par gsal gdab phyir/ /bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'cham cung zad bgyi/ /skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gong ma yon mchod chen po rnams sku tshe brtan zhing / chab srid yar ngo'i zla ba ltar du dar zhing rgyas nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi phyag rgya'i gar 'chams cung zad bgyid pa lags/ 'di la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ yid ches shing khung btsun par bya ba'i phyir/ brgyud pa'i rim pa bstan pa dang / bka' dang mi 'gal zhing gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i gzhung tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud gang nas btus shing / phyogs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba dang / brtsams pa la don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ mdzad pa po gang gi dgos ched ci'i phyir du mdzad cing / don gyi rnam grangs bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir btang gi dbang du byas na chos sku kun tu bzang po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsungs/ de'i sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po la gsungs te/ de yan chad rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa yin par gda'/ de rnams kyi nang nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zab mo lta ba'i phyogs lha'i yul du gsungs zhing rgyas par mdzad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sgrub pa zab mo'i gnad rnams klu'i yul du gsungs zhing rgyas par mdzad/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes drag shul mngon spyod kyi las rnams/

gnod sbyin gyi yul dang mi'i yul du gsungs nas shar phyogs za hor gyi rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i brgyud smin zhing grol bar mdzad/ des mkhas pa mi gsum la bshad de/ des o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ yul dbus kyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra/ bal po'i slob dpon shi la mañju rnams kyis/ bod kyi lo tsā bsnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba la sogs pa la rim pas bsungs te/ de rnams ni rigs 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa yin par gda'/ de nas rim par brgyud de/ slob dpon rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa'i bka' srol gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i grub pa brnyes pa sha stag tu byon pa rnams snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin par gda'/ gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i gzhung tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud gang nas btus shing phyogs gang gtogs ngos bzung ba ni/ phur pa'i 'chams phur pa spyi rgyud nas btus shing / dgra bgegs grub kyi 'chams dang 'gugs 'dren gshed kyi 'chams gnyis rtog 'joms rgyal po'i rgyud nas btus la/ phyogs a nu yo ga rjes su rnal 'byor shes rab kyi rgyud du gtogs pa yin par gda'/ gsum pa brtsams pa la don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ mdzad pa po gang gi dgos ched ci'i slad du mdzad cing / don gyi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ gnas dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ dus gsang sngags sgra ji bzhin par bshad pa'i skabs su bdud ru tra thar pa nag po log pa'i lam la gol ba'i tshe/ 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas/ chos kyi sku spros pa med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i sku khrag 'thung 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can gyi/ glu drug blang ba'i don bzhi rdzogs/ stabs drug skyod pas 'gro drug sgrol/ /zhes stang stabs rnam pa drug gam brgyad kyi sgo nas sems can gya ིdon mtha' yas pa mdzad cing /

bar du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dus su dam chen spyi'i 'chams la sogs pa sa 'dul gyi 'chams rnams mdzad pas/ lha 'dre'i gdug rtsub zhi nas dge 'dun gyi sde dang / gtsug lag khang khyad par can rnams kyi 'gram btings/ gzhan yang ma zhang khron pa skyes tshe las 'das nas gshin 'dre drag pos khyer ba la/ slob dpon chen pos 'gugs 'dren gshed kyi 'cham sogs mdzad pas rnam shes chos dbyings su gnas spor ba'i dgos pa byung ba yin par gda'/ rjes mjug tu lta ba chos nyid zab mo'i don rtogs shing yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba'i sngags 'chang gis phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub pa la sogs pa'i dgos ched khyad par can gyi dus su/ bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams bgyis pas/ sa gzhi byin gyis rlob cing / bkra shis pa dang / bar chad bzlog pa'i dgos pa yod pa lags/ don gyi rnam grangs bstan pa la/ sngon 'gro la don tshan bco lnga/ dngos gzhi la rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis/ rjes la rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal nas/ bkra shis kyi mjug bsdu ba rnams kyi dpal chen rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'chams ston pa lags/ 'di thams cad la thun mong du dgos pa'i yan lag ro stod la seng chags pa/ sked pa la 'grim chags pa/ sgyid pa la ldem chags pa/ tshigs bzhi la 'phrul chags pa/ rkang mgo la bde chags pa/ zhag sha la lhod chags pa/ rnam 'gyur la 'gying chags pa/ sha 'gyur la mer chags pa/ spyod pa dal la 'dod pa/ phyag rgya g.yas su 'cha' zhing / 'grol na g.yon du blta zhing 'gying / g.yon du de las ldog dbus su thad kar blta zhing 'gying / khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba'i tshul gyis phod ka'i thang sha bcad pa/ gangs stod kyi seng ge g.yu ral dkrug pa'i tshul gyi ma ral gyi 'khril bshig pa/

rgya stag nags la mchong ba'i tshul gyis lus kyi 'dzum bstan pa/ gzhan yang rnam rtog ma yengs par lha'i bskyed rim dran pa dang / gral gyi phreng ba bar thag snyoms pas ha cang dal ba dang / brel ba'i skyon spangs nas phyag rgya'i rnam 'gyur bde zhing 'grig pa gal che ba lags so/ /ces 'di gsar bu'i blo can 'gas/ /mang po'i dbus su 'chams 'dod pas/ /myur du gyis ces rab bskul te/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i dge slong gang / /ā nan+da yis 'bad pas bris/ /dge bas ma gyur skye dgu kun/ /zab mo'i lam gyi rjes zhugs nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i dpal thob shog/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
